crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: cortextos bus update-cron-fire heartbeat --interval 4h 2>/dev/null; TASK_ID=$(cortextos bus create-task "Cron: heartbeat" --desc "Scheduled cron run" 2>/dev/null); cortextos bus update-task $TASK_ID in_progress 2>/dev/null; Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update heartbeat, check inbox, run fleet health check across all 3 repos.

crons.name: repo-health
crons.prompt: cortextos bus update-cron-fire repo-health --interval 4h 2>/dev/null; TASK_ID=$(cortextos bus create-task "Cron: repo-health" --desc "Scheduled cron run" 2>/dev/null); cortextos bus update-task $TASK_ID in_progress 2>/dev/null; REPO HEALTH CHECK — Check git log --oneline -5 for each repo (~/code/clearpath, ~/code/lifecycle-killer, ~/code/nonprofit-hub, ~/code/auditos). Check Railway deploy status if any recent commits. Report anomalies to Josh via Telegram 6690120787. If all healthy, skip silently. Format: *Repo Health — [date]* with bullet list of issues. SILENT-OK if all healthy.

crons.name: upstream-sync
crons.prompt: TASK_ID=$(cortextos bus create-task "Cron: upstream-sync" --desc "Scheduled cron run" 2>/dev/null); cortextos bus update-task $TASK_ID in_progress 2>/dev/null; cortextos bus update-cron-fire upstream-sync --interval 7d 2>/dev/null; UPSTREAM SYNC CHECK — Run: cd /Users/joshweiss/cortextos && git fetch upstream. Check: git log --oneline HEAD..upstream/main | wc -l. If >0 commits pending: extract list (git log --oneline HEAD..upstream/main) and changed files (git diff HEAD..upstream/main --name-only). Telegram to 6690120787 with summary of pending commits and file categories (skills, dashboard, core, tests). Reference .claude/orchestration-fleet-build/research/upstream-merge-conflict-map.md for conflict resolution strategy. NEVER auto-merge — present to Josh and wait for approval. SILENT-OK if up-to-date.

crons.name: dependency-audit
crons.prompt: TASK_ID=$(cortextos bus create-task "Cron: dependency-audit" --desc "Scheduled cron run" 2>/dev/null); cortextos bus update-task $TASK_ID in_progress 2>/dev/null; cortextos bus update-cron-fire dependency-audit --interval 7d 2>/dev/null; DEPENDENCY AUDIT — For each repo (~/code/clearpath, ~/code/lifecycle-killer, ~/code/nonprofit-hub, ~/code/auditos): (1) npm audit — flag high/critical vulnerabilities. crons.name: weekly-security-audit
crons.prompt: TASK_ID=$(cortextos bus create-task 'Cron: weekly-security-audit' --desc 'Weekly 10-vector security audit across all clearworksai agents' 2>/dev/null); cortextos bus update-task $TASK_ID in_progress 2>/dev/null; cortextos bus update-cron-fire weekly-security-audit --interval 7d 2>/dev/null; WEEKLY SECURITY AUDIT — (1) Create output dir: mkdir -p ~/code/knowledge-sync/raw/areas/clearworks/security-audits. (2) For each agent in ~/code/cortextos/orgs/clearworksai/agents/ (academy, auditos, auditos2, frank2, hunter, larry, maven, muse, sage, sre): invoke the /agent-security-audit skill with AGENT_DIR=<full path>, save full report to ~/code/knowledge-sync/raw/areas/clearworks/security-audits/<agent>-$(date +%Y-%m-%d).md. (3) cortextos bus complete-task $TASK_ID --result 'cxportal-pull complete; previous night checked' 2>/dev/null. SILENT-OK if previous row green and tonight's run green.
